text:
Elena Park: Heads up — we're seeing a noticeable spike in 5xx errors on the hosted inference gateway since the canary roll started at ~09:12 UTC. Error rate up ~8% (mostly 502/504). Several CS tickets opened reporting timeouts and unexpected charges. Investigating, tagging SRE-Oncall.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout 'canary/v3.4.1' started by @Maya Chen at 2026-03-17T09:12:32Z :rocket:

Omar Reyes: grabbing gateway + pool logs now. Early signs: increased upstream read timeouts to model pool (gpu-beta-3). Routing shows a higher-than-normal proportion of traffic to that pool from canary-tagged requests.

Devon Li: looking at config service history — I see the binary flag `enable_kv_prefetch` was toggled to `true` for the canary group as part of the rollout commit. That should help latency normally but could increase K/V cache pressure if miss-rate spikes.

Maya Chen: I flipped the prefetch on in the canary to test tail latency improvements. Didn't expect auth/billing to be impacted. Rolling it out only to canary.

Support-Bot: 5 new customer tickets in last 10m. Priority: one high - CustID:C-98765 reports repeated 502s and 'being billed for failed requests'.

Elena Park: Can someone share quick repro steps so CS has something to pass to customers and we can reproduce in staging?

Devon Li: Repro (staging): run a load of parallel 50 reqs to /v1/generate with prompt ~1k tokens, repeated for 2 minutes. We see 504s after ~30s. Gateway logs correlate with high kvcache miss-rate and backend stalls.

Omar Reyes: tail from gateway: `upstream read timeout` -> `502 Bad Gateway`. Also seeing retry storms causing transient 429s from internal rate limiter (clients retrying).

Maya Chen: I'm initiating a rollback for the canary flag. Flipping `enable_kv_prefetch` back to false for canary group now.

deploy-bot: Config change applied for canary: `enable_kv_prefetch=false` by @Maya Chen.

SRE-Oncall: Taking these actions: 1) Increase shedder threshold for canary traffic, 2) enable fallback to smaller model variant for traffic_tag=canary, 3) scale pool-gpu-beta-3 by +2 instances. Monitoring now.

Elena Park: Tell CS to proactively message impacted customers. Suggest offering temporary credits for failed token charges — finance aware? @Maggie Harper from support to coordinate messaging.

Maggie Harper: On it. Notified C-98765 and C-12345, creating CS ticket #4321 for billing review and temporary credits.

Maya Chen: Quick note — prefetch path has an edge-case where high miss-rate causes uncontrolled inflight prefetches, leading to backend congestion. I have a PR coming to add backpressure and inflight caps.

Devon Li: Relevant log snippet from staging run: 
```
ERROR gateway: upstream read timeout (pool: gpu-beta-3)
TRACE: kvcache: miss-rate=0.92 inflight_prefetch=256
```

Support-Bot: Alerts show 5xx dropped significantly after flag rollback and scale-up. Created incident ticket and assigned to eng-team for RCA.

Elena Park: Current status: 5xx rate returning to baseline over the last 6m. We'll keep monitoring for 30m before marking resolved. Postmortem and follow-up actions assigned to @Maya Chen and @Devon Li (root cause: canary flag enabling kvcache prefetch without backpressure controls). Action items: add circuit-breaker for canary, backpressure on prefetch, and billing credits runbook.

Maya Chen: Opening PR & runbook: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/484 — implements inflight cap + metrics.

SRE-Oncall: Recommend holding global rollout of `enable_kv_prefetch` until PR validated in canary + new canary circuit-breaker in place. Also will add canary-specific telemetry dashboard for kvcache miss/inflight and upstream-latency.

Elena Park: Thanks everyone. Postmortem draft will include timeline, impact (customers, billing), and remediation plan. Tagging labels: priority:high, action:billing-credits. Will update CS and close incident when stable for 30m. :thumbsup:
